query_freeze: All query/reference selections derived from source before analyzer predictions; no failed project may be dropped or roots shrunk.
entry_contract: Source modules initialize once; Project runs each selected runtime module initialization as an independent root scenario. No arbitrary request coverage is implied.
cost_contract: One analysis worker per case/mode; full inclusive wall/CPU and sampled process-tree RSS include front end, Native predecessor, AI, oracle, adapters and export. Phase clocks may be inclusive/nested and must not be blindly summed. Missing phase counters remain null.
soundness_limit: Concrete finite reference containment and literal source facts are regression/quality observations, not full-Python soundness or whole-project call recall.
